title: Finerenone alleviates the high glucose-induced fibrosis in HK-2 cells by inhibiting EMT via the TGF-beta1/Smads signaling.
authors: Wang, Yanqiao; Liu, Qiuyue; Zheng, Zili; Zheng, Quanlin; Chen, Ruoji; Zhang, Shaoxin
one_liner_zh: 研究药物Finerenone通过TGF-beta1/Smad信号缓解高糖诱导的肾细胞纤维化，分子对接仅用于药物-受体结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Finerenone is a novel non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist and exhibits anti-fibrotic effects against diabetic nephropathy (DN), but its underlying mechanism of action remains unclear. This study aimed to elucidate the effects of Finerenone on high glucose (HG)-induced fibrosis in HK-2 cells and explore the underlying mechanisms. Finerenone was used to treat HG-stimulated HK-2 cells. ELISA and immunofluorescence assays were used to evaluate extracellular matrix (ECM) accumulation and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT). Western blotting and molecular docking were performed to investigate the interaction of Finerenone with TGF-beta1/Smad signaling. ALK5 knockdown experiments were conducted to confirm Finerenone's target specificity. Finerenone significantly reduced HG-induced fibronectin, collagen III, collagen IV and alpha-SMA expression. Moreover, Finerenone restored E-cadherin while suppressed N-cadherin and vimentin levels. Notably, it did not alter TGF-beta1 production, but inhibited Smad2/3 phosphorylation. Molecular docking showed its competitively binding site to TGF-betaR1, knockdown of which abolished Finerenone's anti-fibrotic effects. Finerenone mitigates HG-induced fibrosis in HK-2 cells by targeting TGF-betaR1 and inhibiting downstream Smad signaling to modulate ECM accumulation and EMT. These findings provided mechanistic insights into Finerenone's potential as a therapeutic agent for DN.
abstract_zh: Finerenone是一种新型非甾体类盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂，对糖尿病肾病（DN）表现出抗纤维化作用，但其潜在作用机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在阐明Finerenone对高糖（HG）诱导的HK-2细胞纤维化的影响，并探讨其潜在机制。使用Finerenone处理HG刺激的HK-2细胞。采用ELISA和免疫荧光实验评估细胞外基质（ECM）积累和上皮-间质转化（EMT）。通过Western blotting和分子对接研究Finerenone与TGF-beta1/Smad信号通路的相互作用。进行ALK5敲低实验以确认Finerenone的靶点特异性。Finerenone显著降低了HG诱导的纤连蛋白、胶原蛋白III、胶原蛋白IV和alpha-SMA表达。此外，Finerenone恢复了E-cadherin，同时抑制了N-cadherin和vimentin水平。值得注意的是，它未改变TGF-beta1的产生，但抑制了Smad2/3磷酸化。分子对接显示其与TGF-betaR1存在竞争性结合位点，敲低该受体后消除了Finerenone的抗纤维化作用。Finerenone通过靶向TGF-betaR1并抑制下游Smad信号传导，调节ECM积累和EMT，从而减轻HG诱导的HK-2细胞纤维化。这些发现为Finerenone作为DN治疗药物的潜力提供了机制性见解。
